title: The Rift Tide
text: The Rift Gate breathes out. A grey tide rolls through the lower streets, changing whatever it touches: rats with men's hands, a well that sings, a cobbler who will not stop growing.

options.label: Burn the lower streets before it spreads, and bear the city's hatred.

outcomes.text: The fire stops it. The lower town will never forgive you, nor forget who gave the order.

options.label: Raise walls and wait for the tide to ebb, hoping it takes nothing with it.

outcomes.text: It ebbs in a week, leaving salt and shells that whisper when held to the ear.
It ebbs, but not all of it. In one House, the tide stayed in someone.

options.label: Send the Houses' alchemists to bottle it; something that changes things is worth a fortune.

outcomes.text: Glass jars of grey tide line the shelves. To the right buyer they are worth a fortune, and there are always right buyers.
The jars crack in the night. The tide gets out and goes slowly home through the Houses.
The jars crack. The Scion asleep beside them wakes with webbed hands and a taste for the marsh.
